mechanism.name: Hoshino–Yanagi：保留干扰的环形网络IV

sampling.unit: 一个完整500节点网络实验为一行；n表示独立重复网络实验数，节点按列展开
sampling.dependence: One row is an entire fixed 500-node ring experiment with 1500 observed columns. Rows are independent repeated encouragement assignments conditional on fixed coefficients; nodes within each row are dependent. No no-interference or iid-node assumption.

assumptions: 独立Bernoulli鼓励分配；网络固定；自身鼓励单调影响自身处理；相应DGP限制间接路径；分母非零；不假设节点之间独立或无干扰

properties.notes: No baseline covariates; 500 node instruments/treatments/outcomes are a single dependent experiment, not500 independent rows or confounders. Threshold treatment and explicit ring-neighbor spillovers. Both original DGPs grouped as scenarios in ONE family. Baseline-dimension convention: p=0, effective_p=0, baseline_columns=[]; instruments, posttreatment variables, time points and network nodes are excluded. Reference sample size n_ref=128 complete 500-node network experiments (the CPU interface-check setting), p/n_ref=0.00000000; high_dimensional=false refers to baseline p in this stated setting, not the full observed-column count. n remains a runtime argument; reassess the dimension/sample-size regime if n or p changes rather than treating this tag as a guarantee for arbitrary scaling.

adaptations: Preserve both source network DGPs and L=2/3 as four scenarios in one family, not two new families.

Original N=500 retained. One collection row is an entire network; n=128 means128 independent encouragement experiments on the same fixed network, with all node columns observed. This adapter requires a network-aware benchmark.
Freeze a new disclosed realization of original coefficient distributions; author frozen vector/seed is unavailable.

Use unconditional IEM (constant exposure mapping) and unconditional direct-IV ratio rather than the paper selected t=2/t=1 conditional estimands; derive this target explicitly. No changes to source outcome/treatment mechanisms.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
